edge_thesis: The macro regime has shifted from liquidity-driven multiple expansion to fundamental earnings support, creating dislocations where algorithmic momentum traders chase breakouts while institutions absorb retail limit orders at key moving averages. The strategy isolates mean-reversion and trend-continuation setups by positioning against exhausted short-term liquidity grabs, using tight structural stops to exploit the asymmetry between algorithmic stop-runs and genuine order-flow absorption.
